orders: Complete physical examination, including vital signs and focused examination of the patient’s stated concern
served: deep tendon reflexes and plantar responses
results: 1. Complete physical examination, including vital signs and focused examination of the patient’s stated concern
mental status / cognitive screen: minimally conscious; impaired cognition
muscle tone examination: increased tone; Ashworth grade 1+ upper limbs and grade 2 lower limbs after treatment
limb strength (MRC) examination: not reliably testable because of impaired consciousness and myoclonus
deep tendon reflexes and plantar responses: brisk deep tendon reflexes; extensor plantar responses
coordination examination (limb and truncal): not testable
posture and pull test: abnormal posture; pull test not testable
dx_raw:
DIAGNOSIS: Sporadic Creutzfeldt–Jakob disease (prion-associated rapidly progressive encephalopathy)

ALTERNATIVE 1: Autoimmune encephalitis, particularly anti-NMDA receptor encephalitis

ALTERNATIVE 2: Hypoxic–ischemic encephalopathy

ALTERNATIVE 3: Toxic–metabolic encephalopathy with myoclonus and pyramidal signs
